top_signals.title: CTO of ‘RansomwareHelp’ Indicted for Wire Fraud
top_signals.summary: The chief technology officer and co-founder of ransomwarehelp.com, a six year old Florida business that claimed to use "advanced cryptographic tools" to restore data locked by ransomware, has been charged with wire fraud after an FBI sting operation found the company was simply paying the attackers for a decryption key and charging victims a markup for work that was never performed.

top_signals.title: Yardeni Cuts S&P 500 Target After Stock Selloff
top_signals.summary:
Wall Street strategist Ed Yardeni cut his S&P 500 Index year-end forecast for the second time in about two months in the wake of a powerful stock selloff that pushed the benchmark into a technical correction.
The president and chief investment strategist of Yardeni Research Inc. sees the index closing out 2026 at 7,500 points, down from the reduced target of 7,900 he projected in September. That would still represent a recovery of more than 8% for US stocks from where they ended on Friday.
For details, Bloomberg's Nathan Hager speaks with Ed Yardeni of Yardeni Research.  (Source: Bloomberg)
